newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Evans Deakin says wins rail contract.
newsitem.headline: Evans Deakin says wins rail contract.

text.p: Engineering group Evans Deakin Industries Ltd said on Thursday Walker-ADtranz Pty Ltd had been awarded a further contract valued at A$82 million by Queensland Railways to build an additional 36 suburban electric railcars for the Brisbane suburban train fleet.
Evans Deakin said its content of the contract is A$40 million.
Evans Deakin said the railcars would be built at Evans Deakin's Walkers plant in Maryborough, Queensland, and the project would be managed by Walkers on behalf of Walkers-ADtranz.
The order lifts the company's forward order book for railcars to more than 200 vehicles with deliveries extending beyond the turn of the century.
In April, Evans Deakin said it had won A$65 million worth of work after Queensland Railways awarded a contract for the construction of 54 suburban electric railcars.
Adtranz is jointly owned by Swedish-Swiss group Asea Brown Boveri and Daimler-Benz Transportation, a unit of Daimler Benz AG.
